orchestration.expected: Wait for the yielded gate process to finish before starting another gate command
orchestration.observed: Archive probe and status commands were refused while the Tether current probe retained the lock
orchestration.root_cause: The collector was still running; the caller treated an incomplete poll as completion
orchestration.correction: Wait for session completion; run archive controls once after READY, never concurrent gate commands

tether_current.observed: Anonymous app.tether.to/transparency.json read timed out with no response body
tether_current.classification: Availability observation, not input admission and not evidence that historical data do not exist
tether_current.next_action: Distinct historical archive and provider controls within the frozen input budget; no repeated current API request

local_process_check.next_action: Use the active exec session completion and gate receipt; no privileged process inspection needed

archive_access.observed: Four fixed issuer-date availability requests and one distinct Tether CDX index request ended with TLS EOF
archive_access.next_action: No repeated archive requests; issuer documents and provider controls assessed separately

llama_size.observed: The full single-asset response exceeded 8 MiB and was retained as an incomplete prefix
llama_size.root_cause: Response exceeds the frozen per-response limit
llama_size.next_action: Distinct documented daily charts endpoint, unchanged size limit; incomplete response not parsed or admitted
